Rs 108 Crore Railway Overbridge Project Begins in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh

A Rs 108-crore project to construct a four-lane railway overbridge (ROB) between Guntur and Nambur in Andhra Pradesh has commenced. Minister Somanna highlighted the railway expansion in Andhra Pradesh in connection with the project's start.
